Exhibition, on now

Field Notation

A room that keeps count. Every drawing here was made by repeating one small decision until it filled the space it was given.

Dates
5 September to 22 November 2026
Rooms
Rooms 1 and 2
Hours
Tuesday to Sunday, from 11:00
Entry
Open to everyone, no booking
01

A wall marked once a day

Room 1 holds the wall. Room 2 holds everything that came off the table.

The wall in Room 1 was started in March and marked once each day the building was open. Nothing was corrected. Where the hand slipped, the slip stayed, and where two marks landed together the count continued as if they had not.

Room 2 is quieter. Twelve ruled sheets are laid on a long table at waist height, so you read them standing, in the order they were made. The folded field near the window is held down with pins that were counted out of the same box as the days.

Works are listed in the order you meet them, starting at the door from the courtyard.

In the room

The sound piece plays once an hour, on the hour. If you arrive between two playings, the bench by the courtyard window is the best place to wait, and the light there changes faster than the drawings do.
